title: Plakar Backblaze B2 Storage Connector Config

access_key.description: Backblaze application key ID (the 'keyID' column in the B2 console)

secret_access_key.description: Backblaze application key (the 'applicationKey' shown once at creation)

region.description: B2 region, e.g. us-west-004. Derived from the endpoint host when omitted.

endpoint.description: B2 S3 endpoint host, e.g. s3.us-west-004.backblazeb2.com

use_tls.description: Enable TLS when talking to the B2 endpoint

tls_insecure_no_verify.description: Disable TLS certificate verification (dangerous; use only for testing)

use_path_style.description: Address the bucket as a path element rather than a virtual host
